ValidationRule.description: A QA can only be tagged with either one of Case/Interaction or have a reference field. It cannot have more than one value updated on the related records.
ValidationRule.errorConditionFormula: ((NOT(ISBLANK( Related_Case__c )) && NOT(ISBLANK( Reference__c ))) || (NOT(ISBLANK( Interaction__c )) && NOT(ISBLANK( Reference__c )))|| (NOT(ISBLANK( Interaction__c )) && NOT(ISBLANK( Related_Case__c)) && ( Related_Case__c <> Interaction__r.CaseId__c )) ) && $Setup.Salesforce_Library_Settings__c.Disable_VRs__c = false
ValidationRule.errorMessage: You may only select one record type per quality assessment. Please select one of the following records {Related Case, Interaction, Reference}
